python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Terminal-Bench//Meeting Scheduler//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    "UID:team-planning-meeting-20240117@example.com",
    "DTSTAMP:20240110T000000Z",
    "DTSTART:20240117T110000Z",
    "DTEND:20240117T120000Z",
    "SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Planning meeting for Alice, Bob, and Carol.",
    "LOCATION:Conference Room",
    "ATTENDEE:mailto:alice@example.com",
    "ATTENDEE:mailto:bob@example.com",
    "ATTENDEE:mailto:carol@example.com",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
    "",
]

with open("/app/meeting_scheduled.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write("\r\n".join(lines))

print(Path("/app/meeting_scheduled.ics").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
PY
